raw_text: India's entire UPI payment infrastructure is down this morning due to what appears to be a massive DDoS attack on NPCI. Transaction failures across all major banks. This is a serious national security concern as UPI processes over 10 billion transactions monthly. Botnet reportedly traced to Eastern European IPs. RBI crisis plan activated.
clean_text: UPI infrastructure down from DDoS attack on NPCI. National security concern given 10 billion monthly transactions. Eastern European botnet identified, RBI crisis plan activated.
